Every conversation receives this same question, already checked to have one correct answer. Returns the exam, the difficulty and the expected time in seconds. tools.description: Submit one option id for a ComputePrep drill. Returns whether it is right or wrong and how many attempts remain. A wrong guess does not name the correct option. tools.name: get_drill_hint
tools.description: Name the drill type and ask for the first step on a ComputePrep question. Does not reveal the option or the worked explanation. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

tools.name: get_practice_drill
tools.description: Open one extra ComputePrep practice question, checked to have one correct answer. This conversation can open 2 practice questions today (the anonymous allowance). These are not today's shared drill and they are not in the attempt ranking. Pass lang hi for Hindi.
